description: A unified AI Receptionist learning record for the authenticated business. One entity models all improvement signals: AI-generated learning opportunities raised at session close and user-initiated "Improve answer" corrections. Returned inside `{ data }` for Staff-scoped APIs under `/v3/online_presence/ai_receptionist_learnings`. Date-time fields use ISO 8601 format. Soft-deleted records are not returned in normal API responses.

business_uid.description: Business that owns the learning record (e.g., "biz_2f8f7ab1").

conversation_uid.description: UID of the AI Receptionist conversation this learning refers to (e.g., "4f609f56-cb57-43c5-956c-252f20d67cb0").

source.description: How the record originated. **ai_opportunity** — generated by the AI Receptionist at session close as a question for the business owner about how to improve future answers. **user_improve_answer** — created by a staff member submitting a correction from the chat history "Improve answer" flow (e.g., "ai_opportunity", "user_improve_answer").

status.description: Lifecycle state. **open** — an AI opportunity awaiting the owner's answer (unanswered). **answered** — the owner provided input and the BizAI training chat was launched. **applied** — an actual business rule or configuration change was written as a result (a completed improvement). **dismissed** — the owner dismissed the opportunity (e.g., "open", "applied").

target_type.description: What the learning is scoped to. **conversation** — the whole chat. **message** — a specific assistant message identified by `message_index` (e.g., "conversation", "message").

message_index.description: Zero-based index into the conversation transcript `messages` array for `message`-scoped records; null for `conversation` scope (e.g., 6).

message_snippet.description: Short first-words snippet of the referenced assistant message, for display when linking back to the transcript (e.g., "Thank you, Itzik. Could you please provide your phone number...").

question.description: The AI Receptionist's question to the business owner about how it should have answered. Present for `ai_opportunity` records; null for `user_improve_answer` (e.g., "How should I have handled the pricing objection?").

answer_text.description: The business owner's answer/correction. Feeds the BizAI training chat bootstrap message. Null until the owner responds (e.g., "Offer the standard 10% first-time discount before quoting.").

applied_rule_uids.description: UIDs of the business rules and/or configuration records written when this learning was applied. Populated together with `status='applied'` (e.g., ["rule_9a1b", "rule_2c7d"]).

bizai_conversation_uid.description: UID of the BizAI training chat conversation that handled this learning, for traceability (e.g., "3f21ba90-1c4e-4d2a-9b77-11aa22bb33cc").

created_by_staff_uid.description: Staff UID that authored the answer or the "Improve answer" correction (e.g., "evcq5xg3epuw2c1a").

answered_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the owner answered (e.g., "2026-05-10T13:20:11.000Z").

applied_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when an improvement was actually written (e.g., "2026-05-10T13:25:44.000Z").

example.message_snippet: Thank you, Itzik. Could you please provide your phone number...
example.question: The visitor pushed back on price. How should I have responded to keep them engaged?
example.answer_text: Offer the standard 10% first-time discount before quoting, and mention the free consultation.
